messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: Elevated 502/504s observed from private-egress-gw in eu-west-1. Error spike starts ~3392104000, current error rate ~18% for private-inference-gateway-prod. Paging oncall @mike_oncall :rotating_light:

mike_oncall: acked. I'm on it. Posting initial triage.

raj_net: jump in — seeing lots of TCP RSTs out of the private NAT gw to peer 10.20.0.0/16. Looks like ephemeral port exhaustion + some pkt drops.

mike_oncall: what do logs show on the gateway? any SG denies?

raj_net: SGs look unchanged since last deploy but there was a peering route change from infra earlier today (route 10.20/16 pointing at transit-appliance-b). Could be asymmetric path. tcpdump shows SYN->SYN-ACK but 0x04 RSTs from transit side intermittently. Snippet:
```
20:12:03.123456 IP 10.0.4.12.52134 > 10.20.1.10.443: Flags [S], seq 12345, win 64240
20:12:03.123457 IP 10.20.1.10.443 > 10.0.4.12.52134: Flags [S.], seq 54321, ack 12346, win 28960
20:12:03.123458 IP 10.20.1.10.443 > 10.0.4.12.52134: Flags [R], seq 54322, ack 12346, win 0
```

sara_prod: on product side we see many 502 Gateway Errors from private deployments, customers on dedicated/private are impacted (inference requests timing out then 502s). Full stack traces point to upstream connection reset.

alice_support: observed ticket surge: 7 customers reporting timeouts, 2 escalations. Kavita from customer ops says a big enterprise in EU is seeing high error rates.

mike_oncall: quick mitigations we can try: 1) add temporary NAT SNAT pool to increase ephemeral ports 2) failover peering to standby transit in same AZ 3) increase keepalive / reduce connection churn from frontends. I can flip peering if network team ok.

raj_net: confirmed we can add ephemeral range. Running command to extend on gateway config now: `sudo iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE --to-ports 1024-65535` (will apply to appliance container). Pushing now.

mike_oncall: doing a controlled failover to transit-appliance-a in eu-west-1b for subset of nodes (canary) to see if error rate drops. Routing via alternate path.

eng-sre: be cautious — some customer traffic requires specific path. We'll only move non-customer-locked routes. Starting canary of 10% of private-egress instances.

raj_net: ephemeral pool increased, NAT session table count dropped from 198k -> 42k within 2 minutes. Monitoring for errors.

mike_oncall: canary traffic switched at 10:18:30. Initial metrics: error rate for canary hosts -> 1.3%, baseline hosts still ~17%. Looks promising.

alice_support: notifying impacted customers: posting status update to private deployments status page, note we're failing over transit routes and adding NAT pool.

kavita_customer_ops: customer X (enterprise-eu) acknowledged mitigation—saw immediate improvement on their requests. Will hold until stable 30m.

raj_net: traceroute from problematic host to peer shows asymmetric hop set after route change earlier today. Suspect BGP multipath weighting applied incorrectly at injector. Filing follow-up with infra-bgp team.

mike_oncall: mid-incident decision: keep canary switched and roll remaining nodes to transit-appliance-a across both AZs over next 15m. Keep NAT pool change permanent until BGP fix.

eng-sre: rolling now. Watch CPU on transit-appliance-a — scaling policy will add extra instance if story > 70% CPU.

(5 minutes pass)

mike_oncall: bulk roll completed at 10:40. Error rates dropped cluster-wide to 1.1% within 6 minutes. Latency improved ~120ms p95.

raj_net: confirmed SGs did not block anything; root cause is route weighting flip causing asymmetric path/backpressure at transit appliance which led to SNAT exhaustion and many midstream RSTs.

sara_prod: product impact summary for postmortem: private inference gateways in eu-west-1 showed elevated 5xx (502/504) for ~35 minutes. Estimated P99 error spike affected ~8% of requests at peak. Major customers experienced increased latency and retries; two had failed-run jobs.

alice_support: tickets updated. Customer mitigation notes attached. Two customers requested SLA credit preemptively — routing to bizops.

mike_oncall: followups: 1) infra-bgp team to revert/adjust multipath weighting and add route prechecks (raj to own) 2) make NAT ephemeral range automated scaling (eng-sre to own) 3) add monitor alert for SNAT table saturation (alerts -> oncall) 4) document failover runbook for private-egress (mike to own)

raj_net: created bug: INFRA-5482 "BGPD multipath weight caused asymmetric egress leading to SNAT exhaustion". Linked to this thread.

eng-sre: will implement SNAT autoscale and add dashboards.

mike_oncall: handing off to @oncall_next for post-incident monitoring and follow-ups. Any objections?

oncall_next: ack. I'm taking handoff. I'll keep monitoring until metrics stable for 1h. Please add me to any follow-ups.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Started: 3392104000, Mitigated: 3392104320, Affects: private-eu-west-1, Impact: 5xx/timeouts on private inference gateways, Sev: P2.

mike_oncall: closing active paging. Postmortem will be uploaded to #postmortems with timeline and customer impact. Thanks everyone :heart: 

sara_prod: adding note: ensure docs for customers about expected failover behavior when private peering flips (we should set expectations).
